name: procurement-desk-ui
description: Source and local preview for the n8n Procurement Desk form pages (not part of the Gateway build)

scripts.setup: npm install --no-package-lock && npx playwright install chromium && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.cache/n8n',{recursive:true})" && npm pack n8n@2.47.0 --pack-destination .cache && tar -xzf .cache/n8n-2.47.0.tgz -C .cache/n8n package/templates
